title: Scientific Workload Scheduler — Overview and definition
t: Scientific Workload Scheduler — Overview and definition
description: Queues and schedules scientific compute jobs fairly across a cluster.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Queues and schedules scientific compute jobs fairly across a cluster. A scientific workload scheduler queues batch jobs, allocates CPUs/GPUs by fair-share policies, and backfills idle capacity. Real implementations include Slurm, PBS Pro, and HTCondor. It enforces quotas, predicts wait times, and keeps utilization high without starving small jobs.
capabilities: Priority queues with fair-share and QoS policies

body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. How Scientific Workload Scheduler is actually implemented. A scientific workload scheduler queues batch jobs, allocates CPUs/GPUs by fair-share policies, and backfills idle capacity.
